A '''Gamorrean''' [[Gender/Legends|male]] served on the [[Star Jewel/Legends|''Star Jewel'']], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Minstrel-class space yacht/Legends|''Minstrel''-class space yacht]], during [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. When the ''Jewel's'' [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] captured the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Kyle Katarn]], the Gamorrean and [[Unidentified Gamorrean 2 (Star Jewel)|another]] escorted Katarn to the ship's beast pit, which held Jabba's favorite [[Kell dragon/Legends|Kell dragon]]. After an ill-fated discussion between Jabba the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and Katarn over a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]], in which Jabba expressed regret over not being able to witness the [[Death/Legends|execution]] in person, the two Gamorreans pushed Katarn into the pit. The agent was stronger than they realized, however, when Katarn killed the [[dragon]] with his bare hands. Katarn eventually rescued his partner, [[Jan Ors]], and together they escaped the ''Star Jewel'' in his recovered [[Moldy Crow/Legends|ship]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Gamorrean first appeared in the [[1994]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]'', first appearing in one of the game's cutscenes. The Gamorrean can later be encountered during the level again, where the player can kill the Gamorrean.
